paragraphs: In Sukkah 15b they said: “Shall we say this supports him?” and Abaye explains his words there.[^1]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital paragraph of Sukkah 15b explicitly has Rabbi Ami bar Tavyomi and “Shall we say this supports him?” The local title and direction of support are preserved. Abaye’s explanation is Hyman’s accompanying description; no additional legal material or personal identification is imported.
